SceneMode.combatHint: Infusions drain at the start of each caster's turn.
SceneMode.conversationHint: One round is one round of contributions (about a minute). Use Advance round.
SceneMode.endeavorHint: One round is one round of contributions. Use Advance round.
SceneMode.freeHint: Outside scenes one round is about 10 minutes: advancing world time drains infusions automatically.

Field.Label: Description
Field.FreeWhileInvested: No drain while caster is Invested

Dialog.Title: Infusion
Dialog.LabelHint: Optional: a short note to tell this infusion apart, e.g. "the crate by the door".
Dialog.LabelHintArea: Describe the infused area or surface, e.g. "the floor of the great hall".
Dialog.InstantSurge: This surge is instant and doesn't normally create an infusion.
Dialog.UnwillingCap: Unwilling target: at most {cap} Investiture (Multiple Lashings).
Dialog.NoTargets: No targets. Target tokens and click "Use targeted tokens", or add a text target.
Dialog.ChargeHint: {charge} more Investiture will be taken from the caster (current: {inv}).
Dialog.SustainedHint: Sustained: the caster pays for it from their Investiture at the start of each turn, or ends it.
Dialog.SustainedChargeHint: Sustained: {charge} Investiture will be taken from the caster now (current: {inv}), then 1 each turn it is maintained.
Dialog.UpkeepHint: Upkeep effects cost 1 Investiture at the start of each turn or end.
Dialog.HealthHint: Fine Control objects and physical illusions end at 0 health.
Dialog.EditPoolHint: Editing doesn't charge or refund the caster; use Add Investiture or Reclaim for that.

Hint.AutoSuccessHeld: Automatically succeeds on an object the target holds or wears.
Hint.HardenedDefense: Hardened Defense: only one Tension infusion can raise a character's Physical defense.

Prompt.Title: Start of turn
Prompt.Intro: Investiture: {inv}/{max}. Choose what to keep up this turn.
Prompt.Empowered: Empowered: Investiture refills to maximum before the drain.
Prompt.LastInvestiture: Spends your last Investiture: your sustained infusions end.

List.DamageHow: Damage dealt to the infused object or illusion
List.DrainHow: Investiture drained. Target a token first to give it the drained Investiture.
List.Multiplier: Toggle double drain until the end of next round

Panel.Title: Infusions
Panel.Squire: Squire (base surges only, no talent modifiers)

Tracker.Title: Infusion Tracker
Tracker.EndAllConfirm: End every active infusion (for example at the end of a scene)?
Tracker.DrainHint: Advance round sends each caster their start-of-turn window; Continue all closes windows left open by players who stepped away. Drain and double drain are GM tools.

Mapping.Title: Surge and talent mapping
Mapping.Intro: Overrides for surge action ids, talent effects and action presets, as JSON. Keys: surgeActions, actionPresets, talentEffects, subEffects, formulas. Set a key to null to remove a default.
Mapping.MissingTalents: Not found in the Handbook compendium: {talents}
Mapping.NoHandbook: The Stormlight Handbook module isn't active.
Mapping.NotObject: The overrides must be a JSON object.

Chat.Highstorm: A highstorm passes: spheres are infused again.

Notify.QueuedForGM: No GM is connected: the change will be applied when one joins.
Notify.UpkeepTracked: {name} will ask for upkeep at the start of each turn.
Notify.NotEnoughSpheres: {name} recovered only {recovered} of {missing} Investiture: not enough infused marks or broams.
Notify.NoGMForCommit: No GM is connected: this change can't be applied to an actor you don't own.
Notify.RegenerateFailed: Regenerate couldn't be used. Use it from the character sheet.
Notify.RegenerateNoInvestiture: Regenerate: not enough Investiture left after the upkeep.
Notify.RegrowthFailed: Regrowth: the healing formula "{formula}" couldn't be rolled. Check it in Surge and talent mapping.

triggerMode.Name: Drain trigger
triggerMode.Turn: At the start of each caster's turn (activation)
triggerMode.Round: At the start of each round

bossDrain.Name: Boss turns
bossDrain.Hint: Bosses take a fast and a slow turn each round.

promptOnTurn.Name: Start-of-turn window
promptOnTurn.Hint: Ask the caster to add, reclaim or end infusions before the drain.

autoPromptOnUse.Name: Offer infusion on surge use
autoPromptOnUse.Hint: Open the New infusion window after using a surge that infuses.

whisperChat.Name: Whisper summaries
whisperChat.Hint: Send drain summaries only to the caster's owners and GMs.

tokenMarkers.Name: Infused markers
tokenMarkers.Hint: Show an "Infused" effect on infusion targets.

subEffects.Name: Infusion effects
subEffects.Hint: Infused characters get the infusion's effects (Skate, Basic Lashing, Hardened Defense, Regrowth...) as active effects.

worldTimeDrain.Name: Drain with world time
worldTimeDrain.Hint: Advancing world time drains 10-minute and daily infusions (and round infusions in Free time).

sphereTracking.Name: Track spheres
sphereTracking.Hint: Breathe Stormlight turns infused marks and broams dun; a GM highstorm re-infuses them.

breatheRefill.Name: Breathe Stormlight refills
breatheRefill.Hint: Without sphere tracking, Breathe Stormlight refills Investiture to maximum.

endEnhancedEffects.Name: End Enhanced with upkeep
endEnhancedEffects.Hint: When Enhance isn't maintained, turn its Enhanced effects off.

mappingMenu.Name: Surge and talent mapping
mappingMenu.Label: Configure
mappingMenu.Hint: Check or override the identifiers used to detect surges and talents.

EffectDesc.skate: Skate: spend {cost} focus to Move {path} across the ground as if it were ice.
EffectDesc.restrained: Restrained while fully lashed to something larger.
EffectDesc.basic-lashing: Flying rate {value} ft. Falls when the Lashing ends.
EffectDesc.regrowth: Recovers health at the start of each of this character's turns.
EffectDesc.hardened-defense: Physical defense +{value}. Only one Tension infusion raises a character's Physical defense at a time.
EffectDesc.slide: Slide: counts as one size smaller when squeezing through spaces, and has an advantage on tests to escape restraints that hold through friction or pressure.
EffectDesc.swift-regeneration: Injury rolls +{value} while the caster has Investiture.
